definitions.explanation: A passage or walkway inside a building that connects rooms or areas.

examples.japanese: {廊下|ろうか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{走|はし}らないでください→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
examples.english: Please don't run in the hallway.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{廊下|ろうか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{廊下|ろうか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{点|つ}けてください→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: Please turn on the hallway light.

notes:
{廊下|ろうか} refers to indoor hallways or corridors. ⟦{廊|ろう}→廊：noentry⟧ means corridor and ⟦{下|か}→下：noentry⟧ means under, originally referring to covered walkways.

- ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{廊下|ろうか} (school hallway)

- ⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{廊下|ろうか} (home hallway)
